{{Quote|Look--stick around a minute. I don't know if you're familiar with the situation, but Grathan's a nightmare. The Sith Lord's gone rogue. He's holed up in his estate past the Wall. He's got weapons, shields and a cadre of scientists developing new tech to use against us.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarnova]]|<ref name="TOR:TWM" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] led a '''rebellion''' against the [[Dark Council]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|Capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TOR:GF" />
